newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: HORSE RACING-CLASSIC PARK SURPRISE IRISH GUINEAS WINNER.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-CLASSIC PARK SURPRISE IRISH GUINEAS WINNER.

text.p: Classic Park, ridden by Stephen Craine, gave Irish champion trainer Aidan O'Brien his first classic winner as the filly won the Irish 1000 Guineas at the Curragh on Saturday.
There was further celebration for O'Brien as stablemate Strawberry Roan took second place a length behind.
After Oh Nellie had made most of the early running, 20-1 shot Classic Park eased into the lead inside the last two furlongs and never looked like being headed.
It equalled the longest winning odds in the race since it was first run in 1922.
Christy Roche on the more strongly fancied Strawberry Roan put in a storming finish but had left the run much too late.
Strawberry Roan was priced at 4-1 while another 20-1 shot Caiseal Ros was third two and a half lengths further back.
